ThingDef.label: biomass refinery
ThingDef.description:
Purifies 10 raw biomass and 1 neutroamine into a base yield of 2 refined biomass. Raw biomass must be stored in adjacent hoppers with their outlets facing the refinery. A colonist delivers neutroamine and prepares the batch, then automated processing begins.
Operators require Intellectual 5, Crafting 3 and Medicine 2. Failure risk reaches zero at Intellectual 10, Crafting 8 and Medicine 6. Skills above these thresholds further improve preparation speed and successful-batch yield, independently weighted 60%, 25% and 15%, up to level 20. By default, a fully expert operator prepares in about 22.5 minutes and a successful batch produces 2 items with a 40% chance of a third. Expert rewards are configurable under Refined Biomass in the mod settings and are captured per batch. Preparation awards experience in all three skills. A failed batch consumes its ingredients and produces nothing.
Default preparation takes 60 minutes at minimum skills, 30 minutes at the zero-failure thresholds and about 22.5 minutes at level 20 in all three skills. Automated processing takes 12 hours, reduced by 5% per available gene processor to a minimum of 6 hours. Operator expertise does not shorten automated processing. Processors must be powered and within normal connection range with a clear line of sight. Active gene assembler jobs take priority, including while their operators are away. Each processor assists only one refinery at a time. Timing and processor bonuses can be changed in GeneFoundry's mod settings.
Consumes 100 W while idle and 1,500 W while processing. Power loss pauses processing; two consecutive in-game hours without power destroy the batch. Restoring power resets the outage timer.
